using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Amazon.Core;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Amazon.BedrockRuntime;
using Amazon.BedrockRuntime.Model;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Connectors.Amazon.Core.Tests
{
    public class BedrockChatCompletionClientTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public async Task StreamChatMessageAsync_LogsErrorOnException()
        {
            // Arrange
            var modelId = "test-model";
            var mockBedrockRuntime = new Mock<IAmazonBedrockRuntime>();
            var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var mockLoggerFactory = new Mock<ILoggerFactory>();
            mockLoggerFactory.Setup(f => f.CreateLogger(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(mockLogger.Object);

            var mockChatService = new Mock<IBedrockChatCompletionService>();
            var mockServiceFactory = new Mock<BedrockServiceFactory>();
            // We cannot mock BedrockServiceFactory directly because it is instantiated inside the constructor,
            // so we will use the real one but override the _ioChatService field via reflection.

            var client = new BedrockChatCompletionClient(modelId, mockBedrockRuntime.Object, mockLoggerFactory.Object);

            // Setup the _ioChatService field to a mock that throws on GetConverseStreamRequest
            var chatServiceField = typeof(BedrockChatCompletionClient).GetField("_ioChatService", System.Reflection.BindingFlags.NonPublic | System.Reflection.BindingFlags.Instance);
            chatServiceField.SetValue(client, mockChatService.Object);

            // Setup the _bedrockRuntime to throw on ConverseStreamAsync
            mockChatService.Setup(s => s.GetConverseStreamRequest(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<ChatHistory>(), It.IsAny<PromptExecutionSettings>()))
                .Returns(new ConverseStreamRequest());
            mockBedrockRuntime.Setup(r => r.DetermineServiceOperationEndpoint(It.IsAny<ConverseStreamRequest>()))
                .Returns(new Amazon.BedrockRuntime.Model.Endpoint { URL = "https://test" });
            mockBedrockRuntime.Setup(r => r.ConverseStreamAsync(It.IsAny<ConverseStreamRequest>(), It.IsAny<CancellationToken>()))
                .ThrowsAsync(new InvalidOperationException("Test exception"));

            var chatHistory = new ChatHistory();

            // Act & Assert
            var ex = await Assert.ThrowsAsync<InvalidOperationException>(async () =>
            {
                await foreach (var _ in client.StreamChatMessageAsync(chatHistory))
                {
                    // Should not get here
                }
            });

            Assert.Equal("Test exception", ex.Message);

            // Verify LogError was called with expected parameters
            mockLogger.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Error,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Can't converse stream with")),
                    It.IsAny<InvalidOperationException>(),
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
